PosteAhora puts social media on autopilot by handing the routine to an AI agent. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Notion, Cursor or any of 15+ MCP-compatible agents and ask for a campaign in plain language — your agent writes the captions, uploads the media, and schedules the week without you leaving chat. Ask it to brainstorm and the ideas land straight on a kanban board, tagged and ready to become scheduled posts.

Prefer to drive yourself? The same workspace gives you one composer and one calendar for 14 networks: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Telegram, WordPress, Dev.to and Tumblr. Photos, carousels, video, Reels, Shorts, Stories and long-form articles are all supported, with native per-platform controls — cover frames, alt text, tagging, privacy levels, reply controls, branded-content and AI-content labels, Duet and Stitch settings.

Everything publishes through official platform APIs. No browser automation, no fragile scripts, no risk to your accounts.

For developers there's a public REST API, an MCP server, a CLI on npm, and native n8n, Make and Zapier integrations — so PosteAhora drops into any workflow you already run.

Built for solo creators, indie makers and small marketing teams who post across many networks and want the routine automated. Secondary: developers and AI-agent power users who want social publishing callable over MCP or API, and small agencies managing multiple client accounts.
